The '''Heart of Gamorr''' was a [[Color/Legends|green]] gemstone, the center of which glowed. It was owned by [[Vortga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], who regarded it as his favorite possession. To certain collectors, the Heart of Gamorr had a value of 50,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="LoNH" />
